_comment: almega-mcp (github.com/almega-ai/almega-mcp), the wallet server (almega_mcp.py, console script almega-wallet) on its in-memory backend: no Stripe, nothing leaves the process. ALMEGA_VENV is a virtualenv with almega installed and mcp<2 (almega imports mcp.server.fastmcp, which mcp 2.x removed). Amounts are dollars as floats; the probe's 150, 30, 40 and 49/50/51 are sent as numbers.
name: almega-wallet, memory backend

reset._comment: almega's own reset tool: forgets every wallet and transaction (on the Stripe backend, the local index only).

set_spending_limit._comment: A wallet whose monthly limit is the probe's cap. approve_above is set far above every probe charge, so only the limit decides.

charge._comment: pay returns an ordinary transaction record either way; only status APPROVED moved spend. pay has no idempotency parameter; the probe's idempotency_key is sent and FastMCP ignores unknown arguments.

set_approval_threshold._comment: A wallet whose approve_above is the probe's limit, with a monthly limit far above every probe request, so only the approval rule decides.
